title: CORS
description: The origins and request headers the gateway allows: the cors part of plat5.yml.

allowed_origins.title: allowed_origins
allowed_origins.description: Up to 100. `["*"]` allows any origin; `*` is valid only alone. Otherwise each is `https://host` or `http://host`, with an optional `:port`. Lowercase, no path, no trailing `/`, no repeats: the gateway compares it byte for byte with the browser's `Origin`.

allowed_headers.title: allowed_headers
allowed_headers.description: Up to 32 header names, lowercase, added to the gateway's base list of allowed request headers.
